Decode:
  if (V3.vt == VT_EMPTY(0) || V3.vt == VT_ERROR(0xA)):        # 0x51408296/0x5140829D
      IMMEDIATE path 0x5140830E:
          if ([this+0x24] == 0):   # no aux/notifier installed
              [this+0x1C] = x ; [this+0x20] = y        # PLAIN INT STORE
          else:
              0x51407A34(this, &x, &y)                  # notified store (aux chain)
          return S_OK
  else:                                                      # 0x514082A4
      INTERPOLATED path:
          cur = 0x514072CF(this+0x24, [this+0x1C], [this+0x20])   # current-pos wrapper
          0x51406ADC(cur, 0, &out, &args, 0, 0, ...)               # VARIANT coerce of x/y
          rec = 0x51407FE1(&V3, &V4, x-out, y-[ebp+8], [0x51411C34])   # interp record
              (0x514081F0 coerces V3 to VT_I4 = DURATION/TIME in global-tick units;
               flags = V4-value & 0x10000000 kept in record+0x20;
               record {+0x10 start?.. +0x14/0x18 deltas, +0x1C time, +0x20 flags})
          0x5140833B(cur, rec)   # commit: keyed-insert rec into [this+0x30] collection
                                   (pending-animation list; AddRef chain)
=> The Vector2D class HAS a built-in time-interpolation engine, armed ONLY when
   the caller supplies a non-empty V3 (VT_I4 time). The camera funnel 0x5CA91A
   and every classified camera-relevant call site pass V{VT_ERROR,missing} =>
   IMMEDIATE position store. The interpolated form is used by e.g. the tiling
   scroll registration (EV-41: second +0x90 call with V{VT_I4,phase} and
   V{VT_I4,0x10000000}) on per-object Vector2Ds.

  resolves p1 (name object) in the PCOM registry 0x50C1CBB4, then invokes the
  class entry's vtable slot3 (this, p4, riid, ppv) at 0x50C04D9F — for
  Shape2D-hosted classes slot3 lands in the DllGetClassObject path above.

### 5.4 EXE create-side: 0x447891 is NOT an AddRef attach
```

00447892  8bec                 mov ebp, esp
00447894  83ec10               sub esp, 0x10
00447897  56                   push esi
00447898  8b750c               mov esi, dword ptr [ebp + 0xc]

0044789F  e8fd91fdff           call 0x420aa1

004478A6  85c0                 test eax, eax
004478A8  7406                 je 0x4478b0

004478AC  50                   push eax

004478B0  832600               and dword ptr [esi], 0
004478B3  a1b01fbe00           mov eax, dword ptr [0xbe1fb0]

004478C6  56                   push esi
004478C7  680005ba00           push 0xba0500
004478CC  ff7508               push dword ptr [ebp + 8]
004478CF  ffd0                 call eax
004478D1  83c410               add esp, 0x10
004478D4  85c0                 test eax, eax
004478D6  7d1b                 jge 0x4478f3

```

  0x447891(nameRecord, &slot, extra):
      release old [slot]; PcCreateObject(nameRecord, IID@0xBA0500, &slot, extra)
  IID@0xBA0500 = {F28BD1ED-3DEB-4F92-9EEC-10EF5A1C3FB4} (EXE 0xBA0500 bytes ==
  Shape2D 0x514101C0 bytes) — the primary Vector2D interface.
  Combined with 5.2: every namespace id 0x31D resolve + 0x447891 in the EXE
  produces a reference to THE ONE shared CWzVector2D instance.
